name: planban
description: Codex planning workflows for Planban boards, local or online.

interface.shortDescription: Use Planban roadmap boards in Codex, local or online.
interface.longDescription: Planban helps Codex agents discover roadmap state, read card specs and plans, launch the board, and update roadmap items with the Planban status protocol. Boards stay on your computer with no account; take one online at app.planban.ai to share it.
defaultPrompt: Start work on a Planban card.
